provenance.statement: Contracts/spfn-mobile-contract.v1.json was hand-authored inside spfn-mobile during Step 2. It was NOT exported by SPFN primitives CI, and no SPFN primitives commit is referenced, because the mobile contract export tooling does not exist yet.
provenance.whyThisIsNotAnUpstreamPin: Pinning a digest is only meaningful if it names something an independent party produced. This digest names a file this repository wrote, so it proves the generator and both SDKs read the same bytes, and it proves nothing about SPFN primitives.
provenance.replacementRule: When upstream export tooling exists, the exported bundle REPLACES this file, status becomes RESOLVED_UPSTREAM, and source.repository / source.commit / source.exporterVersion carry real values. Editing this bundle to look upstream-exported is the specific failure tools/validate/validate.sh section 4 exists to catch.

digestDiscipline.rule: manifestSha256 must be the real SHA-256 of the file named by contract.bundlePath. tools/validate/validate.sh recomputes it, and tools/contract-codegen refuses to generate when it does not match, so a tampered bundle fails on both paths rather than producing plausible clients.

notes: Floating branches or URLs are prohibited as a lock source; only an exact path plus digest, or an exact repository, commit SHA and exporter version, are acceptable.
A published contract version and digest are never modified. A mistake becomes a new version.
The bundle carries no secret and no real private key.
